2122826811667263749.en_summary: (Reply) Critical of AOI: $956M commitments vs $605M cash requiring more financing. Actions contrary to CFO comments on US bank financing up to $500m and leaning into debt; spent $102M on Texas buildings then another $550M ATM amid tight conditions. Contrasts with $COHR funding capacity via upfront prepayments.
2122826811667263749.zh_summary: （回覆）批評AOI：$956M承諾對比$605M現金，需要更多融資。行動與CFO評論相反（美國銀行融資可達$500m，更傾向債務）；在現金相對低時花$102M買德州建築，隨後又$550M ATM，融資環境緊張。對比$COHR用預付款資助產能擴張。

2122826762060988682.en_summary: $NVDA - Huge guide of 75% growth by Colette into next year. Speaks to demand and backlog confidence in AI GPU chips. Huge for Nvidia, tech sector, and market given the ongoing Jensen black cloud situation. Nvidia is the one chip fueling AI.
2122826762060988682.zh_summary: $NVDA - Colette給出明年75%增長的巨大指引。顯示AI GPU芯片的需求和積壓信心。對Nvidia、科技板塊和市場巨大利好，儘管Jensen黑雲情況持續。Nvidia是推動AI的唯一芯片。

2122826718033408014.en_summary: $NVDA Colette Kress closes earnings call: NVIDIA ready to move beyond Jensen Huang. Quote: “Our momentum is real. Our demand is accelerating. Our supply is growing. Our customers and our partners are with us. And employees are committed. We've got this.”
2122826718033408014.zh_summary: $NVDA Colette Kress結束業績電話會議：NVIDIA準備好超越Jensen Huang。引述：「我們的勢頭是真實的。我們的需求正在加速。我們的供應正在增長。我們的客戶和合作夥伴與我們同在。員工們致力於此。我們做得到。」

2122826684353446157.en_summary: Jensen Left. Nvidia’s Role as the Central Bank of AI Didn’t. First results since Jensen Huang resigned 12 Nov: under interim CEO Colette Kress, revenue $115.8bn, guide $130bn. Max exposure under guarantees to $118bn from $108.5bn, including new $9.5bn credit-support for power/systems. Leases/cloud to $102bn from $74bn. $105bn OpenAI Ohio backstop remains. Funded $15.7bn equity in quarter (YTD $58bn). Kress: neoclouds/frontier labs growing faster than balance sheets. Nvidia underwrites demand it can see via guarantees/equity. Governance changed but financing strategy not. Binding constraint is capital/power/concrete, Nvidia still supplies them. $NVDA
2122826684353446157.zh_summary: Jensen離開。Nvidia作為AI中央銀行的角色沒有。Jensen Huang 11月12日辭職後首份業績：臨時CEO Colette Kress下，收入$115.8bn，指引$130bn。擔保下最大敞口從$108.5bn升至$118bn，包括新$9.5bn電力/系統信貸支持。租賃/雲從$74bn升至$102bn。$105bn OpenAI俄亥俄後盾仍在。季度資助$15.7bn股權（年初至今$58bn）。Kress：neoclouds/前沿實驗室增長快於資產負債表。Nvidia透過擔保/股權承銷其可見需求。治理改變但融資策略不變。制約是資本/電力/混凝土，Nvidia仍供應它們。$NVDA

2122826292110221652.en_summary: $NVDA CFO says supplier financing is NVIDIA's top capital allocation priority, including prepayments to help suppliers expand capacity and accelerate production. "The top priority is going to be our suppliers... some of that supply needs assistance in terms of capital, from different types of prepaids..."
2122826292110221652.zh_summary: $NVDA CFO表示供應商融資是NVIDIA首要資本配置優先事項，包括預付款幫助供應商擴產能並加速生產。「首要優先是我們的供應商……部分供應需要資本協助，從不同類型的預付款……」
